title: I Tried Shopify Dropshipping For 7 Days (Realistic Results)
summary: Seven-day AI dropshipping test on a $250 budget: store, products and ads built with AI tools; about $400 revenue and roughly $80 profit, so the $1,000 challenge failed.

assertions.quote: engage with every drop shipping ad you see
AI pretty much did everything for free.

verdicts.note: Store builders, copy and image generators do produce a functional store quickly; whether it sells is a separate question.

assertions.quote: this AI UGC tool is great for quickly generating lots of different ad variations
That leaves us with a profit of $81 and 56 cents. So clearly I failed the challenge.
I also ended up spending around $150 on meta ads
this store could definitely make $1,000 in profit every month

verdicts.note: A prediction with no follow-up; some stores improve with optimization, most are abandoned.
